lead_raw_text:
The structure of Li6Fe2Co2O10 (reduced formula Li3FeCoO5) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 20 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Co in tetrahedral O environments (4 neighbors, 2 atoms) and Fe in octahedral O environments (6 neighbors, 2 atoms), while Li centers have 4 O neighbors (8 atoms). Validated polyhedron-sharing relations reveal corner-sharing between Co tetrahedra and Fe octahedra and between Fe octahedra, with additional corner- and edge-sharing among Li-centered 4-vertex polyhedra; the periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component.
